newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish bourse kerb bond deals - October 14.
newsitem.headline: Polish bourse kerb bond deals - October 14.

text.p: Turnover in kerb trade through the Warsaw bourse was at 105.4 million zlotys on Monday.
The following is a summary of the day's block transactions on the Warsaw bourse.
* 83,150 fixed-interest, five-year bonds maturing on October 12, 2000 traded at 90.05 zlotys.
* 12,044 fixed-interest, five-year bonds maturing on June 12, 2000 traded at 92 zlotys.
* 18,906 fixed-interest, five-year bonds maturing on June 12, 1999 traded at 94.4 zlotys.
